question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH promo_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS promo_net
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE is_promo = TRUE
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net
    FROM fact_sales
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN total_net = 0 THEN NULL 
         ELSE promo_net / total_net 
    END AS promo_net_ratio
FROM promo_sales, total_sales

question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH sales_by_region_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_id,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(f.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON f.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_id, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,

        total_qty,

FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 7 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS july_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 8 THEN f.qty ELSE 0 END) AS aug_qty
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON f.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year = 2026 AND d.month IN (7, 8)
    GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category
FROM monthly_sales
WHERE aug_qty > july_qty

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低
sql:
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.region,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales f
    JOIN dim_outlet d ON f.outlet_id = d.outlet_id
    GROUP BY d.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        net_sales,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS running_total,
        SUM(net_sales) OVER () AS total_sales
    FROM region_sales
)
SELECT 
    region,
    net_sales,
    running_total / total_sales AS cumulative_share
FROM ranked
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

question: 有多少个终端和单品的铺货组合在2026年8月完全没有销售
sql:
WITH listed_combos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT outlet_id, sku_id
    FROM rel_outlet_sku
    WHERE listed_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
      AND (delisted_date IS NULL OR delisted_date >= DATE '2026-08-01')
),
sales_combos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT outlet_id, sku_id
    FROM fact_sales
    WHERE date_key BETWEEN 20260801 AND 20260831
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS combo_count
FROM listed_combos lc
LEFT JOIN sales_combos sc ON lc.outlet_id = sc.outlet_id AND lc.sku_id = sc.sku_id
WHERE sc.outlet_id IS NULL

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少

sql:
WITH period_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN YEAR(f.date_key) = 2025 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN '2025H2'
            WHEN YEAR(f.date_key) = 2026 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN '2026H1'
        END AS period,
        SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales,
        SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS promo_cost
    FROM fact_sales f
    LEFT JOIN fact_promo_cost pc 
        ON f.date_key = pc.date_key 
        AND f.outlet_id = pc.outlet_id 
        AND f.sku_id = pc.sku_id 
        AND f.dealer_id = pc.dealer_id
    WHERE (YEAR(f.date_key) = 2025 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 7 AND 12)
       OR (YEAR(f.date_key) = 2026 AND MONTH(f.date_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 6)
    GROUP BY period
)
SELECT 
    (MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN promo_cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN promo_cost / NULLIF(sales, 0) END)) AS fee_ratio_diff
FROM period_metrics
